# wine_glass

Round 2: **TARGET NOT MET**. 6 dishware instances. Authoritative comparison: [photo, render and overlay](../review/wine_glass_compare.jpg); [numerical report](../qa_report.json). Earlier reconstruction prose is retained in [Round 1 history](../review/round2_before/wine_glass/notes.md).

## Evidence and shape

Same supplied metric OpenCV cameras, WORLD metres with +Z up; GLB uses +Y up. Metric scale is inherited from reconstruction, not a tape measure. Each instance keeps its measured pose, orientation, scale and provenance in `model.json`. Source photographs are motion blurred and some boundaries are occluded; typical manual boundary uncertainty is 8 source pixels.

| Frame | IoU | Photo visible W/H, px | Model visible W/H, px | RGB histogram distance |
|---|---:|---|---|---:|
| f1608 | 0.8629 | [103.0, 209.0] | [97.0, 209.0] | 0.3133 |
| f1611 | 0.8213 | [110.0, 227.0] | [99.0, 211.0] | 0.2742 |
| f1670 | 0.8816 | [193.0, 630.0] | [199.0, 615.0] | 0.2572 |

Visible extents are occlusion-limited measurements, not full product dimensions. Tiny disconnected mask fragments are excluded only from extent measurements; raw extents and all-pixel IoU remain in the report. Canonical visual bounds are `[[-0.04100000113248825, -0.04100000113248825, 0.0], [0.04100000113248825, 0.04100000113248825, 0.21400000154972076]]` metres. Shell/floor assumptions are `0.0013` / `0.003` metres.

## Changes

- Thin transparent shell, IOR 1.5, thick manufactured foot and rounded lip
- Added separate hollow bowl-profile variants, with their own convex contacts and GLB/Blender exports
- Triangulated the neck of every hanging glass in f1608/f1611/f1670 and corrected secondary glass sizes and positions while retaining the independently silhouette-fitted first glass
- Remeasured observed depth surfaces in three calibrated frames
- Re-fitted metric placement, scale, tilt and nesting spacing against fixed cameras
- Computed mass, COM and per-instance inertia from closed shell volumes and material densities

Supplemental all-instance evidence: [three-view comparison](../review/wine_glass_instances_compare.jpg). Visual source/render/overlay review of count, type, visible rim and contact alignment; supplemental landmark fits where recorded. This does not supply a separate silhouette IoU for every instance.

## Material, contact and physics

Empty canonical asset mass: **0.1413 kg**, from closed physical shell volumes and per-part densities. No manufacturer product identification or scale measurement is available. The stored ±30% range is a nominal engineering prior, not a confidence interval. Scale and unobserved wall-thickness uncertainty may be larger. Material: soda-lime glass; friction 0.4; restitution 0.05; fragile `True`. Per-instance masses, mass-weighted COM and inertia use each variant, scale and retained part state.

| Physical part | Density kg/m³ | Mass kg | Canonical COM m |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| body | 2500 | 0.14130 | [0.0, 0.0, 0.10067] |

195 convex contacts follow the floor, segmented thin walls, handles/stems and separate closure parts. They preserve vessel cavities; they are not a liquid boundary. Convexity, watertightness and open-axis checks passed. The individual upright 2-second Blender settling check passed. These checks do not certify assembled stacking, rack hanging, robot grasping, fracture, or friction accuracy.

Joints: `[]`. Detachable parts: `[]`. Rigid vessel; detachable lids/strainers, when listed, remain independent bodies.

Reusable variants: [narrow_tulip](variants/narrow_tulip/model.json), [balloon](variants/balloon/model.json). Prototype files have no independent inventory instances; the parent instance table owns placements.

## Appearance and reproducibility

Glass uses physical transmission, IOR 1.5 and thin inner/outer walls. Glaze and metal parameters are stored in `material_parameters`; they are material priors, not measured BRDFs. Photo rebakes and inferred generated details are documented in [texture provenance](../review/round2_texture_provenance.json). No source object image is inserted into a glass shader or review background. Bounded exposure/white-balance fitting is in-sample, using the same review frames. The offline renderer records actual wall times, sample count, resolution and denoising under `review/`.

Build this asset with `QA_FAST=1 blender -b -P build.py`. Run the set-level `round2_render.py -- wine_glass`, `round2_physics.py`, and `round2_report.py` for calibrated reviews and metadata. `model.glb` is visual geometry; simulation importers must also read the JSON joints and compound collision files.

## Remaining

- Numerical silhouette score covers selected visible instance indices [0]; supplemental three-view instance comparisons and landmark measurements are separate from this IoU. Hidden contacts are not certified
- Appearance target A not reached: masked RGB histogram distance 0.282; environment, view-dependent reflections and unresolved surface detail remain
- Mass is a density/closed-shell estimate with nominal uncertainty (usually ±30%; ambiguous lower-shelf metal cup variants ±65%); product identity and wall thickness unmeasured
- No full assembled stack/rack dynamics, breakage or robot-grasp validation

physics_properties.mass_basis: Closed visual-shell volume times documented material density; excludes open decals; not a manufacturer weight
physics_properties.centre_of_mass_basis: Mass-weighted closed-shell integrals, using separate part densities (including bamboo lids); open decals excluded.
physics_properties.product_identification: Not established; density-based estimate, not weighed or manufacturer verified
physics_properties.friction_basis: User-specified material-pair prior; no slip-angle experiment in capture

sources.description: SCHOTT borosilicate density 2230 kg/m3 and IOR 1.471 demonstrate composition dependence; model uses nominal soda-lime density 2500 and requested IOR 1.5, not a BOROFLOAT identification

physics_properties.contact_model: Rigid compound convex shell bands; thin margins; fragile objects do not fracture. Deformable flags retain explicit rigid fallback.

provenance.geometry: Reconstructed from kitchen video; hidden surfaces are completed. Scale and material appearance remain approximate.
provenance.motion: Observed trajectories where documented; unobserved axes and endpoints are assumptions.
provenance.forces: Simulation measurements of assumed parameters; not force measurements from video.

visual_bindings_note: Visuals use the latest asset revision; mechanism geometry may predate it. Body rest offsets preserve the visual placement.
